## Doctoral Research

**Benchmarking and application of genomic language models (gLMs)** for taxonomic and functional profiling in human multi-omics microbiome research (George Washington University, PhD in Health Data Science – Bioinformatics, expected 2028). My work explores how novel gLMs can improve omics characterization over traditional, search-based techniques.

## Weill Cornell Medical College
*2021 – Present · Collaboration with Dr. Nili Solomonov*

- Applying a Treatment Decision Rule–based framework for optimally assigning patients with late-life depression to psychotherapy vs. usual care — published in [*JAMA Psychiatry*](https://doi.org/10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2025.2518).
- Analysis and visualization of depression trajectories in a large cohort of perinatal women — published in [*JAMA Network Open*](https://doi.org/10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2025.33111).

## George Washington University
*2013 – Present*

- **Master of Science project:** Association of maternal gestational diabetes mellitus with newborn gut metabolome.
- **Machine learning:** Predictive modeling to identify biomarkers associated with asthma comorbidity using both clinical and airway microbiome data.
- **FDA-ARGOS:** Data harmonization to prototype the FDA-ARGOS database of reference-grade microbial sequences, in collaboration with Dr. Keith Crandall.
- **COVID-19 meta-analysis:** PRISMA and other projects — advising on R coding, data wrangling, and data visualization, collaborating with Dr. Fouzia Farooq, Dept. of Global Health.
- **Geospatial analysis:** Collaborated with Dr. Hilary Silver, Dept. of Sociology, on geospatial data analysis of DC homeless shelter proposal feedback from local residents, using R.
- **Maternal health:** Collaborated with Dr. Ethan Litman, GW School of Medicine, on data analysis of maternal deliveries before and during the COVID-19 pandemic.
- **Mental health influencers:** Collaborated with Dr. Bagmi Das, GW School of Education and Human Development, to build data collection for an Asian-American/Pacific Islander Mental Health Influencer Study.
- **Social media & misinformation:** Cross-institutional collaboration led by Dr. David Broniatowski, GW School of Engineering, analyzing and visualizing social media content related to COVID-19.
- **Health topics on social media:** Collaborated with two teams of medical students under the guidance of Dr. Marie Borum, providing data collection and analysis guidance on social media discussion of health topics during the COVID-19 pandemic.
- **Extremism research:** Collaborated with the [GW Program on Extremism](https://extremism.gwu.edu/) to collect and analyze social media from Twitter and Telegram in support of research publications and reports.
- **Text mining:** Collaborated with Dr. Babak Bahador, GW School of Media and Public Affairs, to develop a text mining and data analysis pipeline for transcripts of political talk shows.
- Consulting on numerous graduate-level and faculty research projects involving data analysis and visualization, across a wide variety of disciplines.

## Software Projects

- **[Social Feed Manager](https://github.com/gwu-libraries/sfm-ui)** — open-source tool for building social media data collections for research (Python, Django, Docker).
- **[GW ScholarSpace](https://scholarspace.library.gwu.edu/)** — GWU's institutional open-access repository (Hyrax, Ruby on Rails).
- **[The ISIS Files](https://isisfiles.gwu.edu/)** — Hyrax-based public repository of specialized artifacts, with the [GW Program on Extremism](https://extremism.gwu.edu/).
- **Open Access Analytics** — data pipeline and dashboard tracking GW Open Access Policy compliance.

See [Experience](experience.qmd) for more on these projects.
